title: The gunship's thermal reads the display picture again: since the sheet fix (9dd92ccd, 2026-11-07) the FLIR pass sampled the scene pass's raw buffer (linear, no bloom, no tone mapping or sRGB), so the seat went dark and the bodies cold
context: The owner, 2026-11-12 evening, after playing the pushed build 5c6d3b52: "the thermal view of the gunship feels different than before, and slightly worse." No date, no detail. The FLIR (src/fx/flir-pass.js) is a final pass after postfx's tail that maps the picture's luminance onto the ironbow, so anything that changes what it samples changes the whole seat.
outcome: CAUSE: 9dd92ccd (perf pass, 2026-11-07, entry 2026-11-06-the-sheet-was-the-tail-s-swap-the-pass-no-longer-swaps-the-base-batched) set AddOutputPass.needsSwap false to keep the scene pass on the multisampled target. With the FLIR enabled the tail is not the last pass, so it wrote its picture to the composer's write buffer and did not swap; the FLIR then read the read buffer, which still held the scene pass's raw linear render. The perf entry's 'the picture unchanged' held for the ordinary view, not the seat. SEEN (headless, same page and seed at four commits, index.html?acceptance=1&world=story&stage=6&gunship=station, seat after the briefing's skip): before (e527eff4, 2026-11-06) the ground purple with orange-yellow cell lines, the base white-hot with a glow, the bodies at the sinkhole orange-yellow; at 9dd92ccd and at HEAD the ground near black, the lines thin pink, the base flat orange with no glow, the bodies dark purple with warm rims only, the sky darker. Crop mean luminance of the optic at the seat: 60.8 before, 20.6 at 9dd92ccd, 15.4 at HEAD, 51.1 fixed; share of pixels under 40: 13 %, 93 %, 95 %, 30 %. FIX: AddOutputPass swaps again (hands its picture to a following pass) and settleSceneTarget (src/postfx.js) swaps the composer back after each frame whenever the read buffer is not renderTarget2, the boss lab's seat composer's rule (src/labs/boss/game-seat.js), so the scene pass still always draws into the multisampled target with depth. Nothing in src/content changed: the look comes back by the pipeline, not by numbers. NOT CHANGED, the rest of the difference: the base's structures (the dome city, round 8) and the solar/armory colours (6fc0ccc5's weld fix) are content and recorded decisions. Today's commits (8c3b4cef..5c6d3b52) touch no thermal, FLIR, postfx or exposure code; the biomass piles, the rover's gauge sprite, the companions and the dog are not in the base's warm list (src/td-tab.js thermalHeat) and show at their lit luminance.
alternatives: Moving the FLIR into the tail's fragment (one pass, no hand-over): a second shader variant of the output transfer for one seat; the swap and the frame's parity rule are two lines and the lab already used them.
Brightening the FLIR's input with a gain to match the old look: it would approximate the transfer and still miss the bloom; the cause was the buffer, not the numbers.
Giving renderTarget1 depth and MSAA so parity no longer matters: a second full-size multisampled target for nothing (the perf entry's own reasoning).
evidence: test/postfx.mjs: the vendored EffectComposer's render loop over stub passes (scene, tail, FLIR) for five frames with the FLIR toggled: the scene pass always draws into renderTarget2, and with the FLIR on it reads the tail's write buffer and only the FLIR draws to the screen. With the tail's needsSwap put back to false the check fails three times (the FLIR reads the raw scene).

Pictures (untracked, the thermal-look worktree): .superpowers/thermal-look/thermal-1-seat.png, thermal-2-bodies.png, thermal-3-fired.png (before e527eff4 / 9dd92ccd / HEAD 5c6d3b52 / fixed, side by side), thermal-sinkhole-before-head-fixed.png, thermal-bodies-head-vs-fixed.png (a pile of bodies at a structure: dark purple and flat orange at HEAD, orange-hot and white-hot with glow fixed), raw/ the single frames.

Parity in a real browser: 24 consecutive CDP screenshots in the seat and 24 in the tank view on the fixed tree; three blocks' mean luminance changes smoothly with the moving camera, no period-two alternation (the sheet's signature, 2026-11-06), the tank view's structures drawn over the lattice.
npm test: 344 test programs passed. npm run check: green (td-tab 5,349 under 5,450).

Not measured: a headed run at the owner's 3440 width; the browser --gunship suite (red on the base at its shader-program count, not chased); bodies matched frame for frame (spawnFodder's bodies at HEAD are not at the sinkhole after 10 s headless, so the bodies' comparison is the structure crop).
